description:
In this video you will learn about how you can register your two wheeler (motorcycle / bike / scooter / scooty) or four wheeler (car) insurance claim process from your home by yourself. The survey of your accidental vehicle will be done at your home. I have ICICI Lombard Bike insurance for my two wheeler. You will also get to know about accidental repair work, claim settlement etc in this video.

#bike #scooter #car
